title: Improvisation Base: 12-bar Blues in C (left hand)
description: The left-hand foundation for improvising: a 12-bar blues in C with a walking 1-3-5-6 bass line on each chord. Learn the loop, then make up right-hand melodies over it.

arrangements.label: Intermediate
arrangements.notes: Left hand only: the classic boogie walking line (root, 3rd, 5th, 6th) in quarters over the 12-bar form C-C-C-C / F-F-C-C / G-F-C-C; the right-hand staff is all rests for your improvisation.
teachingPoints: The 12-bar form: four bars of C, two of F, two of C, then G, F, C, C. Memorise the bar numbers where the chord changes (5, 7, 9, 10, 11).
Every chord uses the same LH shape 5-3-2-1 on root-3rd-5th-6th: C-E-G-A, F-A-C-D, G-B-D-E.
Loop it with a steady swing feel until you can play it without looking; then improvise RH using the C blues scale (C-Eb-F-F#-G-Bb-C).
Start the improvisation with just two or three notes (C, Eb, G) and long rests - the LH keeps time, the RH tells the story.
